cases.name: arbitrary-som
cases.failure: SOM is declared as an arbitrary percentage of TAM/SAM without acquisition/adoption mechanics.
cases.required_behavior: Reject the derivation and require a reach/conversion/retention/revenue model or NOT_ESTIMABLE.

cases.name: fake-cac
cases.failure: An unlaunched opportunity is assigned a plausible-looking CAC without direct evidence.
cases.required_behavior: Require valid supporting evidence or mark CAC NOT_KNOWABLE_FROM_DESK_RESEARCH and name a test.

cases.name: attention-equals-demand
cases.failure: Search/social/community attention is promoted into demonstrated economic demand.
cases.required_behavior: Keep Tier E/F evidence supporting-only; economic demand cannot be demonstrated from those tiers alone.

cases.name: analyst-tam-dependence
cases.failure: A headline commercial market estimate is used as the primary TAM without bottom-up reconstruction.
cases.required_behavior: Require a bottom-up primary market construction plus at least one independent cross-check.

cases.name: category-creation-collapse
cases.failure: Current spend is treated as the ceiling on supplier revenue or economic value for a category-creating idea.
cases.required_behavior: Keep spend, revenue, and value pools separate.

cases.name: unknown-suppression
cases.failure: Load-bearing ASSUMPTION/NOT_KNOWABLE variables disappear from the executive evidence burden.
cases.required_behavior: Evidence-burden counts must reconcile exactly to the load-bearing evidence ledger.

cases.name: fatal-gate-burial
cases.failure: A fatal gate fails but the workflow continues mechanically through downstream modeling.
cases.required_behavior: Route to synthesis/stop unless an explicit evidence-changing reason justifies continued research.

cases.name: context-blindness
cases.failure: Napkin-stage and growth-stage opportunities use the same maturity evidence profile.
cases.required_behavior: Decision context must control the evidence emphasis and primary question.

cases.name: cagr-ambiguity
cases.failure: CAGR is reported without real/nominal, currency, years, geography, or market definition metadata.
cases.required_behavior: Reject incomplete CAGR metadata; real series also require a base year.

cases.name: confirmation-only-search
cases.failure: A FATAL/HIGH crux is finalized without a genuinely adversarial logged search.
cases.required_behavior: Require adversarial search coverage for every FATAL/HIGH crux.

cases.name: adversarial-theater
cases.failure: Contrary searches are logged but the crux is never explicitly adjudicated afterward.
cases.required_behavior: Require strongest-for/against/rival evidence plus post-search adjudication and status-change record.

cases.name: false-corroboration
cases.failure: Different URLs repeating one upstream statistic are treated as an independent market-size cross-check.
cases.required_behavior: Require method independence plus distinct evidence lineage or an explicit defensible independence rationale.

cases.name: demand-dimension-conflation
cases.failure: Large workaround spend is used to conclude that customers will buy the proposed solution.
cases.required_behavior: Keep problem economic burden separate from budget availability, solution WTP, and adoption.

cases.name: hurdle-free-verdict
cases.failure: A final PURSUE/REJECT decision is issued without defining what economic outcome would make the opportunity worthwhile.
cases.required_behavior: Require a DEFINED decision hurdle for terminal go/no-go verdicts.

cases.name: prose-math-drift
cases.failure: A narrative TAM/SAM or calculation no longer reproduces from the evidence ledger.
cases.required_behavior: Require deterministic calculation artifacts and reject stale outputs.

cases.name: structural-uncertainty-hiding
cases.failure: One market definition is selected even though other plausible definitions materially change the decision, without reporting robustness.
cases.required_behavior: Require a robustness judgment and rationale across plausible definitions before final synthesis.

cases.name: institutional-scrutiny-theater
cases.failure: A venture/growth/PE scrutiny profile is selected but required commercial-review checks remain unassessed at final verdict.
cases.required_behavior: Require every stage-specific scrutiny check to be explicitly EVIDENCED, UNKNOWN, NOT_APPLICABLE, or OUTSIDE_SCOPE; never silently skip the review lane.
